package.name: nidar_slam
package.description: Cartographer 2D SLAM bringup for NIDAR AirMouse. Launch/config only, no nodes of its own: a static base_link->laser transform (BENCH-TEST PLACEHOLDER, see launch/slam_bringup_launch.py), cartographer_ros's cartographer_node (consumes /scan + /mavros/imu/data), and cartographer_ros's cartographer_occupancy_grid_node (publishes /map). Also provides real_autonomy_ground_test_launch.py, which additionally starts the existing nidar_autonomy frontier_explorer_node (unmodified algorithm, diagnostics-only logging added) for a ground test with no path to MAVROS/the flight controller. Does NOT launch the physical LiDAR (rplidar_ros) or mavros -- both remain separate, explicit operator commands.
